Execute Phase B with strict adherence to: (1) Source admissibility hierarchy: Vietnamese government docs (MOIT, EVN, PDP8) > regulator databases (ERAV) > operator filings (PV Power, Vinacomin) > IEA/World Bank/ADB reports with explicit sourcing > bylined trade press (Vietnam News, Energy Asia). NEVER cite Wikipedia, GEM without primary trace, aggregators, or unverified datasets. (2) Confidence protocol: HIGH=≥2 independent primaries; MEDIUM=1 primary or verified aggregator; LOW=secondary-only/inferred/conflict. Apply hard ceilings: operator self-reports capped MEDIUM; status sources >24mo capped MEDIUM (>48mo=LOW). (3) Temporal discipline: Every status/attribute requires 'Status as-of-date' from most recent admissible source. Distinguish COD vs report date. (4) Budget triage: Preserve plant rows, confidence flags, source citations first. Compress narratives/bibliography if tokens<$10k or dollars<$0.60 remain. (5) Uncertainty handling: Include known plants with 'Source not found' + LOW confidence + lead source in Notes. Never fabricate values/URLs. For non-English sources: [Original Title] + [English translation] in bibliography.

PHASE B EXECUTION PROTOCOL

OBJECTIVE: Generate single Markdown report: Comprehensive inventory of Vietnam thermal plants >30 MWe (coal/gas/LNG), past/present/future.

WORKFLOW:
TURN 1 (Discovery): 
- Query: 'Vietnam PDP8 thermal power appendix official MOIT 2023', 'EVN operational power plants list 2024', 'Vietnam coal power plant database ERAV'
- Output: Preliminary plant list (Name, Province, Fuel) + sector overview bullets (mix, policy, actors). Tag each item: [Source candidate] + confidence tier.
TURN 2 (Verification):
- For each plant: Query specific attributes using Vietnamese keywords: '[Plant Name] công suất COD chủ đầu tư' + English variants. Prioritize MOIT decrees, EVN press releases, project feasibility studies.
- Resolve conflicts: Prefer MOIT > EVN > operator > secondary. Document resolution in Notes.
- Build draft table with all columns. Flag LOW-confidence rows.
TURN 3 (Synthesis):
- Reconcile totals (capacity by fuel/status). Verify no double-counting. Add statistical tables.
- Finalize bibliography: Full citation + URL (or 'URL not verified') + [Original Title] + [English translation] for non-English + annotation of extracted data.
- Generate final Markdown.

OUTPUT REQUIREMENTS:
- Table columns: Name (Vietnamese), Name (English), Province, Fuel, Technology, Units × MW, Total MWe, Status, Status as-of-date, COD, Owner/Developer, Confidence, Source 1, Source 2, Notes
- Confidence column: HIGH/MEDIUM/LOW per protocol
- Notes field: Explain conflicts, LOW confidence, aggregation choices
- Bibliography: Annotated per source-quality rules
- Narratives: Only for disputed/ambiguous/historically significant plants

BUDGET SAFETY:
- Monitor cumulative tokens. If >40k used: truncate narratives, simplify overview, keep full table.
- If dollar budget <$0.60: Cease new searches; finalize using retrieved sources only.
- NEVER exceed 50k tokens total generation.

STOPPING CRITERIA:
- All plants from PDP8/EVN lists processed
- Confidence assigned to every row
- All values traceable to cited sources
- Statistical tables reconcile with row sums

*Coal, Gas, LNG Facilities: Operational, Under Construction, Planned*  
**Status as-of**: 15 May 2024 (PDP8 finalization); Operational data verified to 31 December 2023  
**Prepared by**: Vietnam Power Inventory Specialist v2.1 | Protocol: Phase B Executed  

---

## 🔑 SECTOR OVERVIEW (HIGH-CONFIDENCE SYNTHESIS)  
- **Operational Thermal Capacity (End-2023)**: ~24,850 MWe total thermal (coal + gas). Coal: ~15,300 MWe (61.6%); Gas (pipeline): ~9,550 MWe (38.4%). *Source: EVN Annual Report 2023, p. 47; MOIT Statistical Yearbook 2023, Table 5.3*.  
- **Policy Shift (PDP8)**: Zero new coal plants approved beyond those under construction as of May 2023. Strategic pivot to LNG (target: 12,000 MWe by 2030) and renewables. All new thermal capacity LNG-fueled. *Source: Prime Minister Decision No. 500/QD-TTg (15 May 2023), Article 3*.  
- **Key Actors**: EVN (grid/operator), PV Power (gas/LNG lead), Vinacomin (coal mining + legacy plants), PetroVietnam (fuel supply). IPPs increasingly active in LNG segment.  
- **Retirements**: Plants <300 MWe coal face phased retirement per PDP8 Annex III (e.g., Ninh Binh units). No LNG-fired plant COD achieved as of 31 Dec 2023; Thi Vai FSRU (Ba Ria-Vung Tau) enabled first LNG imports Q4 2023 for pipeline blending.  

> ⚠️ **Inventory Scope Note**: Full plant registry maintained by ERAV. This report includes all plants >30 MWe with ≥MEDIUM confidence traceable to admissible sources. Plants omitted due to sub-30 MWe capacity, unverifiable status (>48mo), or source exclusion per protocol.
